reviewer: Codex: first-use material, source-to-sample handoff and actual output review
review_scope: Read all five lesson outlines and contexts, the nine-line journal and the three fictional XML invoice facts. Ten distinct locale/phase native checks execute the current teaching adapter, Journal Sampling prerequisite, Studio Archive handoff and Vouching run, within 29 passing focused checks. Reviewed the localized Markdown notes and eighteen native Excel views: five horizontal views of each distinct phase, plus the localized review-note columns for the other eight cases. All other CSV fields match within each phase; document receipt references vary by run and were traced separately. Canonical spreadsheet columns remain English. The samples and outputs are generated during execution; learner decisions, professional conclusions, voice, two-window behavior and browser widget interaction are not attested.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The plain title teaches checking sampled journal entries against their invoice documents. The sequence covers supplying the inputs, defining the selected rows, performing the actual checks, opening the results, tracing a document and recognizing the review decisions still required.
editorial.inputs_and_request: Read this localized context and the actual fictional journal and XMLs. Nine debit/credit lines represent three purchase invoices; account 2100 contains their three payable lines. Debit and credit totals each equal EUR 2,440. The XML totals are 1,220, 732 and 488, with matching invoice references and dates. The teaching request chooses two random account-2100 rows with seed 42. Placeholder identities are explicitly fictional and no transmission is requested.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The native tutorial adapter binds the journal separately from the context, runs the current Journal Sampling preparation and selection, seals its artifacts and invokes start_check_entries_from_sample with the chosen support receipts. Vouching checks only those selected rows. Checkpoints identify the selected population and require explaining one result from the journal and invoice. No prepared sample, fabricated final output or learner approval substitutes for live execution.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: Actual Excel and CSV results preserve matched documents, monetary facts and pending professional conclusions. Fitted columns and frozen entry identifiers make the workpaper readable; four technical identifier/JSON fields remain available in hidden columns. Native localized review notes now name each entry, date, account, journal amount, document amount, source row, document and outstanding question. They explain reviewing supplier/customer identity and debit/credit direction in ordinary language. Source matching is distinguished from approval; signed support amounts remain withheld until the required review. Initial export and reviewed-note regeneration share the same workbook writer.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: Practice requests a new three-row sample from account 2100 and checks all three selected invoices. The native test preserves the original two-row results and seals the second sample and check run separately. The repeat instruction asks for the correct existing Journal Sampling run and an explicit document batch, with the internal handoff handled by Vera.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Read the it first-use outline, context and native review-note content. Localized row guidance was visually checked in both phase workbooks. Narrative and review notes follow this language; canonical technical column names remain English. Six stages total 390 seconds, with processing and questions allowed to extend the lesson. There is no measured learner-duration or voice claim.

demo.result_review: The actual nine-line journal is normalized, filtered to the three account-2100 rows and sampled to 2 rows. The XML batch parses without errors and the checks return exactly 2 selected rows. Each selected invoice has an explicit reference, matching date and amount magnitude. Supplier/customer and debit/credit review remain pending; status is manual_review and professional_conclusion is pending_review. The generated notes explain those outstanding steps and point to the exact journal row and invoice. The workflow outputs are finalized without claiming professional approval.
